The draft Prevention of Cruelty to Animals (Control and Supervision of Experiment, Breeding and Trading of Laboratory Animals) Rules, 2026 was published last month.
The main objectives of the new rules are summarised in the three Rs – replace, reduce and refine. That is, replace animals with other scientifically satisfactory methods where possible; reduce the number of animals to the bare minimum; and refine the experiments to minimise animal suffering.
